purpose: Independent literal HWC exact-value oracles for the Phase 6 engineering candidate; this file is not production approval.
coordinate_convention: HWC row-major; first index y, second index x; values are ordered by declared channel order.

oracle_policy.review_model: user/project owner plus assistant; no outside reviewer prerequisite

fixtures.purpose: Distinct signed changes per RGB channel prove channel order and independent subtraction.

oracle_review.derivation: For the first pixel, right-minus-current is (10-1,40-20,150-200)=(9,20,-50), and down-minus-current is (50-1,5-20,90-200)=(49,-15,-110). The remaining entries follow the same per-channel subtraction; right and bottom edges replicate and are zero on the terminal axis.

fixtures.purpose: Distinct RGBA and alpha values verify four-channel HWC ordering without alpha special-casing.

oracle_review.derivation: At the upper-left pixel, Dx=(12-2,10-30,50-80,0-255)=(10,-20,-30,-255), and Dy=(7-2,60-30,20-80,128-255)=(5,30,-60,-127). All four channels use the same signed subtraction; replicated edges yield zero only along the terminal axis.

fixtures.purpose: Seeded byte vector exercises varied positive/negative differences and deterministic replay.

oracle_review.derivation: The 36 input bytes are fixed by xorshift32_low_byte_v1 from seed 0x6D2B79F5. Expected values were independently derived channel-by-channel from adjacent pixels using neighbor-minus-current; the terminal x-column and y-row are explicitly zero. The recorded arrays are literal exact oracles, not generated by the C++ test or implementation.
